ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) base with approximately 30-40% high-intensity (white) localized pixel coverage across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density white rosette clusters localized on the mid-to-distal left lobe; distinct high-contrast linear white markings on the inner right lobe adjacent to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 85 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with high-frequency peaks (3-5 pixel amplitude) along the central lobes, transitioning to larger, more jagged protrusions at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the median notch to the tips, terminating in distinct upward-curving distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread distribution of circular white pixel rings (barnacle attachment sites) across both lobes, with highest spatial density on the upper-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 5-7 parallel, vertically-oriented high-intensity linear marks on the right lobe; single diagonal intersecting linear mark on the lower-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel linear scarring (rake marks) on the inner right lobe; heavy accumulation of white circular parasitic/epibiotic lesions globally.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'comb-like' pattern of vertical white lines on the upper-right portion of the trailing edge.
